scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:php && npm run lint:phpstan && npm run lint:theme-json
scripts.lint:phpstan: if [ ! -f theme/functions.php ]; then echo 'lint:phpstan: brak theme/functions.php – pomijam (#36)'; exit 0; fi; vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=1G
scripts.lint:theme-json: if [ ! -f theme/theme.json ]; then echo 'lint:theme-json: brak theme/theme.json – pomijam (#36)'; exit 0; fi; ajv validate --spec=draft7 --strict=false -c ajv-formats --errors=text -s tools/schemas/theme.json -d theme/theme.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:tools && npm run test:js && npm run test:php
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:php:mariadb && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual && npm run test:lighthouse
